entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control
comments: # ── subagent control plane (new in L8) ────────────────────────────
# The parent-to-child direction, registered ONCE and globally named:
# send_message (deliver a follow-up as the child's next FIFO turn) and
# interrupt_agent (cancel only the target's current turn; queued
# messages park, descendants keep running).  Keeping the controls in
# one separately loaded plugin is what lets several provider-bound
# delegation tools (subagent, subagent_fork above) share one control
# API without double-registering it.  No config.  inject = [tools,
# subagents]; the continuation runtime itself comes from ctx.agents
# (dsh-agent, L1), so followup/interrupt are live at this level.
# NOTE: both mounted delegation instances keep backgroundMode
# 'one-shot', so no continuable child can be started yet — the
# controls are wired but have nothing to steer until a
# dsh-tool-subagent instance sets backgroundMode: continuable.

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents
comments: # list_agents rides a separate subpath export (inject [tools,
# subagents, agents]) so a deployment can deliver continuation
# without exposing discovery.  Its schema registers here, but
# every CALL also reads the sessionProjections registry — absent
# until dsh-session-projection (L10) — and fails cleanly with
# SUBAGENT_CONTROL_PROJECTIONS_UNAVAILABLE.  Mounting it now keeps
# the whole closure visible; it goes fully live at L10.

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-report
entries.configYaml:
config:
    # Deployment scheduling policy for accepted reports (the schema
    # default, written out for visibility): next-step delivers through
    # parent.steer() — a running parent receives the report at its nearest
    # step boundary, an idle parent starts a turn.  The alternative 'quiet'
    # uses parent.inject() and never wakes a parked parent.  The
    # model-facing schema cannot override this per call.
    reportDelivery: next-step
comments: # The child-to-parent direction: NOT a global tool but a
# continuable-child setup contribution, so `report` and its
# tool:report prompt section exist only inside continuable
# in-process children — roots, one-shot children, and the parent
# never see them, and the registration survives the child's
# toolFilter so a delegation allow-list cannot strip the only
# return channel.  inject = [subagents, tools, systemPrompt], all
# satisfied in this graph.
